Definition: Kadesh, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Kadesh is the oasis town at the edge of the desert: the well of Beer-lahai-roi lies between Kadesh and Bered, Miriam died there and was buried there. The spies came back to Kadesh with their report of the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Kadesh is where the journey kept returning, and where the people kept learning that the desert was not the end of the story.
